entities.name: Grenzo
entities.description: Scheming goblin of Paliano on Fiora, former dungeon warden and leader of the goblin underclass.

entities.name: Selvala
entities.description: Elf who killed King Brago and was released by Grenzo.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: Plane Grenzo traveled to via omenpaths.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion after which Grenzo traveled to Thunder Junction.

events.summary: Grenzo released Selvala from the dungeons to kill Muzzio, but the plan backfired when she released the constructs in his tunnels.
events.quote: Grenzo released her from the dungeons in a bid to kill the artificer Muzzio

events.summary: Marchesa became queen and fired Grenzo as dungeon keeper; he became leader of a thieving goblin gang.
events.quote: When Marchesa became queen, she fired Grenzo as dungeon keeper.

events.summary: Grenzo found an ally in Daretti.
events.quote: He found an ally in the planeswalker Daretti

events.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion Grenzo traveled to Thunder Junction and became a jailer.
